faq.title: Everything About
faq.subtitle: Learn how disposable temporary email works and why millions trust TempMailCentral for their privacy needs.
faq.question1: What is a temporary email or temp mail?
faq.answer1: A temporary email (also called temp mail, disposable email, or throwaway email) is a self-destructing email address that you can use for a short period. It helps protect your real email from spam, phishing, and unwanted marketing emails when signing up for websites or services.
faq.answer2: Disposable email works by providing you with a random email address instantly. Any emails sent to this address appear in your temporary inbox in real-time. After a set period (typically 10 minutes), the email address and all received messages are automatically deleted.
faq.question3: Is temp mail safe to use?
faq.answer3: Yes, temp mail is safe to use for non-sensitive purposes like signing up for websites, downloading resources, or testing applications. However, you should never use temporary email for important accounts like banking, as the emails will be deleted and you may lose access.
faq.question4: How long does a temporary email last?
faq.answer4: By default, temporary email addresses on TempMailCentral last for 10 minutes. However, logged-in users can extend the time up to 30 days or even save the address as a permanent mailbox.
faq.answer5: Some websites maintain blocklists of known temporary email domains. While TempMailCentral uses multiple domains to minimize this, some strict websites may still detect and block temporary email addresses.
faq.question6: Do I need to register to use temp mail?
faq.answer6: No registration is required to use TempMailCentral. Simply visit the website and you will automatically receive a temporary email address that you can use immediately.
faq.question7: Can I receive attachments with temp mail?
faq.answer7: Yes, TempMailCentral supports receiving email attachments. You can view and download attachments from emails sent to your temporary address.
faq.question8: What is temp mail used for?
faq.answer8: Temp mail is commonly used for: signing up for free trials, avoiding spam from newsletters, testing email functionality in applications, protecting your real email from data breaches, online shopping on untrusted sites, and accessing one-time downloads or resources.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your privacy and handle your data
privacy.introduction: At TempMailCentral, privacy is our top priority. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our temporary email service. By using our service, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content:
We collect minimal information to provide our service:

• Technical Data: IP addresses, browser type, and device information for security and service improvement
• Usage Data: How you interact with our service to improve functionality
• Email Content: Temporarily stored emails that auto-delete after expiration
• Cookies: Essential cookies for service functionality

We do NOT collect:
• Personal identification information
• Payment information (our service is free)
• Your real email address
• Any data we don't absolutely need

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content:
We use collected information for:

• Providing and maintaining our temporary email service
• Improving user experience and service functionality
• Detecting and preventing abuse, spam, and security threats
• Analyzing usage patterns to optimize performance
• Complying with legal obligations

We do NOT:
• Sell your data to third parties
• Use your data for advertising
• Share your information without your consent
• Store data longer than necessary

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing and Disclosure
dataSharing.content:
We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information. We may share data only in these limited cases:

• Legal Requirements: When required by law or to protect our rights
• Service Providers: Trusted partners who help operate our service (under strict confidentiality)
• Security: To prevent fraud, abuse, or security threats

All third-party service providers are bound by confidentiality agreements and are prohibited from using your information for any purpose other than providing services to us.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content:
We use cookies and similar technologies:

• Essential Cookies: Required for service functionality (cannot be disabled)
• Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how you use our service
• Preference Cookies: Remember your settings and preferences

You can control cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling essential cookies may limit service functionality.

We do NOT use:
• Advertising cookies
• Third-party tracking cookies
• Social media tracking pixels

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content:
We implement industry-standard security measures:

• Encryption: All data transmitted is encrypted using HTTPS/TLS
• Secure Infrastructure: Our servers use advanced security protocols
• Access Control: Limited access to data by authorized personnel only
• Regular Audits: Continuous monitoring and security assessments
• Auto-Deletion: Emails automatically delete after expiration

While we strive to protect your data, no internet transmission is 100% secure. Use our service at your own risk for non-sensitive communications.

emailRetention.title: Email Retention and Deletion
emailRetention.content:
Email retention policy:

• Temporary Emails: Auto-delete after 10 minutes by default
• Extended Emails: Delete based on your chosen extension period
• Permanent Mailboxes: Retain until you delete (for registered users)
• Deleted Content: Permanently removed from our systems

Once deleted, emails cannot be recovered. We do not maintain backups of temporary email content.

mission.content: Our mission is simple: protect your privacy online. In a world where your email address is constantly requested, we believe you should have the freedom to maintain your privacy without sacrificing access to online services. story.title: How TempMailCentral Started
story.paragraph1: TempMailCentral was born from a simple frustration: giving out email addresses to websites that didn't need them. Every signup meant more spam, more tracking, and less privacy. We knew there had to be a better way.
story.paragraph2: We started by building a service for ourselves—a simple, fast way to get temporary email addresses without registration. As word spread, we realized others shared our concerns about online privacy. Today, we serve over 500,000 users worldwide who trust us to protect their privacy.
story.paragraph3: We've grown from a simple tool to a comprehensive privacy service, but our core mission remains the same: give people control over their digital privacy. We continue to improve our service, add new features, and expand to new languages—all while keeping privacy at the forefront of everything we do.
